events.description: A bus collides with a car, flips onto its side and roof, skids across the road, and disintegrates while rolling and sliding in dust and debris.

verification.reason: Frames f3–f20 show a continuous sequence: initial impact (f3), bus airborne and overturning (f4–f7), sustained rolling/skidding (f8–f12, f14–f18), and structural failure (f15, f19–f20). All candidate intervals fall within this single crash event; merged accordingly.

events.description: The bus’s side ruptures violently at 10.0 s, ejecting fragments and smoke in a rapid blast-like event.

verification.reason: Frame f15 shows sudden ejection of multiple small objects and yellowish debris from the bus body, consistent with an explosive rupture (not just mechanical breakup); occurs during ongoing crash but is distinct in timing and dynamics from rolling motion alone.
